authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FX-4 crash-matrix initial states from permission-truth-tables.v9. It does not author journal bytes. It does not invent a journal envelope, a grant record, a decision record, or a sequence-number encoding. It does not execute FX-4. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-FX-AUTHORING at FX-4 without inventing journal envelopes. v9 exact bytes are the journal before and after each recovery, compared whole. This catalog records the named L-1..L-8 x write/fsync x macos/linux crash points. The journals remain unauthored.

pttV9.fx4Intent: Crash at every journal write boundary and every fsync boundary for every transition L-1..L-8, on both platforms. Assert after each recovery: exactly one total order; no duplicate sequence number; no gap that recovery filled by renumbering; no *-INTENT record without either a terminal outcome or a recorded INDETERMINATE; and no effect initiated whose intent record is absent. Exact bytes: the journal before and after each recovery, compared whole.
